name: Claude Code Frontend Design Toolkit
hook: Everything that actually makes Claude Code output better-looking frontends — curated into 10 sections covering design styles, theme/color, animations, Figma-to-code, and browser testing. 70+ plugins and skills with CLAUDE.md tricks and MCP servers, organized by the problem you're trying to fix, not by tool type. 416 stars and trending on @GitHubDaily.

name: Claude Marketplace
hook: Single destination for 2,000+ plugins and connectors (Atlassian, Google, Microsoft, Notion, Salesforce), products and agents (CrowdStrike, Cursor, Harvey, Legora, Lovable, Snowflake), and service partners (Accenture, BCG, Deloitte). A commerce agent blueprint ships alongside for operators building shopping workflows. Launched Sept 23.

name: Plugin Directory — Submission Portal
hook: Paid-plan developers can now submit plugins at claude.ai/directory/manage — choose a single MCP connector or a full GitHub-hosted bundle, track review status, and see post-launch analytics. MCP usage is up 110x in 2026. Auto-validation on submit, staged rollout controls, and a live analytics dashboard once published. Launched Sept 25.

name: Claude Tag — Personal Connectors in Channels
hook: Claude in Slack can now reach your personal connectors (calendar, Drive, CRM, staging env) inside shared channels — not just the admin-attached connectors a channel admin added. Choose review-before-posting or auto-post mode. Team plans now; Enterprise coming. Launched Sept 24.

name: Claude Code v2.1.283
hook: Released Sept 25 — 94 changes. Highlights: `/doctor prompt-audit` scans CLAUDE.md, skills, and agent files for outdated patterns and suggests fixes; `deniedModels` managed setting blocks specific models org-wide; `availableModelsMatch: "exact"` locks versions to prevent drift between machines; `x-claude-code-prompt-id` gateway header for request tracing (opt-in via `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`); MCP tool outputs to OpenTelemetry (`OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1`); Mantle provider (Bedrock); load test mode.

name: Chisle v3.5.0
hook: Cuts token bills on three axes: terse prose, YAGNI-first code, and tool-output compression. 52% of bare-model token cost across 20 live tasks, with published benchmarks including runs it loses. v3.5.0 (Sept 19) adds automatic output style detection — picks the right compression mode without any configuration. Zero deps. Real-time savings badge in the status line. Works with Claude Code, Pi, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and 4 more. ~560 stars and growing.

name: BrowserAct Skills
hook: Browser automation skill built for AI agents that treats modern anti-bot detection as a first-class problem: breaks through walls, hands off to humans when stuck, and supports parallel multi-task execution, independent multi-session operation, and isolated multi-account browsing. 5,900 stars.

name: hard-won-skills
hook: Themed plugins of battle-earned habits, each extracted from a real session where not having it cost something: agent-config, git-workflow, data-safety, verification, mobile-ui, and more. Each skill declares the situations and trigger phrases that fire it — Claude picks it up when your task matches ("rebase the open PRs", "do the baselines still pass"). Active releases v2026.09.23 and v2026.09.26.
